notes.title: UPDATE 1.20
notes.notes:
[b]This is a major update. If you have any run prior this update, finish or abandon it before updating. Refer to Update 1.18.[/b]

[h1]Changelogs[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The game aspect ratio increased from 17:13 to 21:13
    [*]New HUD design. HUD is now an actual Head-up Display (moved from the bottom to top)
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/a88f375b3dc6f4f029e19294493efadcfded3e40.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/3b64dda088b79622f03ab773d529ad4328ad2192.png[/img][/url]
    [*]Slight change to some map layout to match the new aspect ratio.
    [*]Horizontal AoE for screen damage increased from 8 to 9.
    [*]Initial starting parameters now doubled to reduce power spike when obtaining novelty.
    [*]Rescaled enemy stats to match new scaling.
    [*]Nerfed Resistance effectiveness against trap damage by half.
    [*]Shovel is now used without accessing the inventory. Usage increased from 2 to 3.
    [*]Reduced max cash from 9999 to 999.
    [*]All room pieces now available without needing to be unlocked.
    [*]Fixed critical error with Card effect.
    [*]New visuals for room exit indicator.
    [*]Entering a room now ping your character location, you are less likely to lose track of your character now.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.18

    [*]Looting after room clear no longer give bonus export.
    [*]Increased export drop chance from 25% to 33%.
    [*]Sack item buff duration increased.

[h1]Map Changes[/h1]
[list]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.notes:
Approximately 3 days since last update. Sorry for slacking off.

[list]
    [*]Belly mechanic removed. Originally, this was intended to limit item spamming, otherwise you can just keep eating and healing and never die. But managing it is tedious, so it's replaced with something simpler:
    [*]Food now have cooldown on use, up to 4 uses every 12 sec. Reset when moving to the next room.
    [*]Reworked diarrhoea ailments into mould; reduce healing from item.
    [*]Reworked some abilities that use belly as resource.
    [*]Removed shovel from starting item. +1 spanner instead.
    [*]WC NPCs removed.
    [*]Buried treasure now visible on the ground.
    [*]Shovel use limit reduced from 3 to 2.
    [*]Attack sound effect changed to be more softer (and less loud).
    [*]Add 5 frame delay between combat turns, a bit of time to react.
    [*]Removed caffeine decay on combat turns, because it's unfair for tank build.
    [*]Interrupt recovery penalty reduced from 50% to 40%.
    [*]Novelty chest now more flashy.
[/list]

And finally about that lag/freeze issue; Coffee Crawl source engine is RMMV, released on late 2015, which is still new. If your PC is made 10 years ago (before 2009) chances are this game will have a poor performance. If your PC driver is blacklisted by OpenGL/Chromium (very rarely) you may encounter some lag too. That, or some weird compatibility issue with other installed software on your PC that not even customer service can help.

TLDR: this game lag on old PC.

Recent PC have no problem, other than some slight stutter on initial startup when the game is loading its resources, that is perfectly normal and will not persist.

Also, UK spelling isn't considered a grammatical error.

notes.title: Update 1.13 & Troubleshooting
notes.notes:
It's been 17 hour since release and we're off to a decent start!
[list]
    [*]All the characters were originally designed to speak in their own native language. But since that isn't favourable, everyone now speaks English. Previous dialogue archived for future use.
    [*]Effect that slows movement speed replaced with stun.
    [*]Maximum speed for enemy reduced.
    [*]NPCs no longer wanders around.
[/list]

[h1] Troubleshooting [/h1]
[list]
    [*]If you experience lag spike or FPS drop, try turning on the Synch monitor FPS from the option menu ( can be accessed in game by pressing 'O' )
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/0b450eedbf85614d904d7d51cc7d82732ac74f84.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/5a8f3059c7c7733ab1c002f1e2373b855c350a07.jpg[/img][/url]
    [*]Additionally, your GPUs/Drivers must be able to  support Canvas/WebGL/OpenGL for the game to run smoothly. Otherwise, download the latest driver for your graphic card from your manufacturer website.
    [*]Game volume and moving speed can be adjusted from the option menu.
    [*]Exiting the game is done by closing the window. It is recommended to quit only after the "Autosaved" prompt appear.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/cc8e223a9ff58b81c764cfd7a8a15f34b25e7d70.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/788ef1fc2c43c8b077f19133113aa1b53c4ba10b.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[h1] 
Coffee Crawl is based on old-fashioned, complex roguelike such as Nethack, DCSS, ADOM, etc. Which, to be honest isn't everyone's cup of tea. As such, it has a lot of hidden mechanics and interaction, which mostly need to be discovered by player themselves. Taking multiple enemies at once is deadly if you didn't exploit corridors. Hunger bar is constantly depleting and must be managed. Like all roguelike, the game is difficult and you're not expected to blaze through everything on your first few runs without dying. This is roguelike, you will die A LOT, and that's the most fun you can have.  [/h1]

Your review is much appreciated.

notes.title: Pre-release Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Two weeks are a long time to wait before release.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted weaker abilities to scale better, but with longer cooldown.
    [*]Removed cheat locker due to potential abuse.
    [*]Buffed Engineer, Bouncer, and Lich class for better early game.
    [*]Removed adventure mode due to balance issue, for now.
    [*]All floor trap buffed.
    [*]Peer spawn rate reduced, spawn location increased from 2 to 3.
    [*]Minimum hour for eligible score increased from 1 to 2.
    [*]Donating to beggar now capped at 4.
    [*]Nerfed Harvester passive scaling from 100% to 75%
    [*]Adjusted some novelties to give cards.
    [*]Unlocks now progress faster.
    [*]Ability cost scaling reduced from lvl/18 to lvl/20
    [*]Deprive countdown now tick faster.
    [*]Autosave frequency reduced.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Cards[/b] now implemented.
    [*]Ability tooltip now display cost/cooldown.
    [*]Forte icons updated for colour blind.
    [*]7th map added: Landfill, Academy, Facility.
    [*]Help for anarchy mode added in manual.
    [*]Peer favour's list now have personal names.
    [*]20 more room pieces for each map layout.
    [*]Credit updated to include some forum members.
    [*]Vault added in locker room to store excess novelty to prevent lag.
[/list]

[h1]Landfill[/h1]
Home of all the unwanted stuff. A lot of enemies here inflict status ailments.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/19969e5925fb50d19d761bec389693240d6b483d.png[/img]

[h1]Academy[/h1]
Mingle with the fellow students. By mingle, I mean kick their ass.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/a60b0f39487c14e105f8411dada334f22632453b.png[/img]

[h1]Facility[/h1]
Robots do love their armour. Have some spanners ready to disarm them.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/afebab424ec27b3c6c2ce1a1516c676440769d9e.png[/img]

[h1]Cards[/h1]
This is new feature allows you to modify the current map by placing either bonuses on yourself to make the map easier, or if you're doing well; add an extra layer of challenge for a reward in the end.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/210e0a7a7f1735bfe234799d4048976ce538c97a.png[/img]
Card example. This one reduce the map overall difficulty.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/8f42ae158243dedea8bb44241938669e38e51aac.png[/img]
This table will spawn at the starting room of each map. You may play up to three cards per map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/547457da3fcdb0992ccd3b4ed25a02e0af181128.png[/img]
Each map contain two cards; chosen from the map's own card pool. you can get more by trading with friendly peers.

[h1]Others[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Reverted RMMV version from 1.5.2 to 1.5.1 yanfly version for better PC performance.
    [*]There's already an in-game achievement system. Steam achievement will not be implemented for the time being due to redundancy.
    [*]This post is for documentation purpose only. The game is not even released yet.
[/list]

Two weeks are a long time to wait before release.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted weaker abilities to scale better, but with longer cooldown.
    [*]Removed cheat locker due to potential abuse.
    [*]Buffed Engineer, Bouncer, and Lich class for better early game.
    [*]Removed adventure mode due to balance issue, for now.
    [*]All floor trap buffed.
    [*]Peer spawn rate reduced, spawn location increased from 2 to 3.
    [*]Minimum hour for eligible score increased from 1 to 2.
    [*]Donating to beggar now capped at 4.
    [*]Nerfed Harvester passive scaling from 100% to 75%
    [*]Adjusted some novelties to give cards.
    [*]Unlocks now progress faster.
    [*]Ability cost scaling reduced from lvl/18 to lvl/20
    [*]Deprive countdown now tick faster.
    [*]Autosave frequency reduced.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Cards[/b] now implemented.
    [*]Ability tooltip now display cost/cooldown.
    [*]Forte icons updated for colour blind.
    [*]7th map added: Landfill, Academy, Facility.
    [*]Help for anarchy mode added in manual.
    [*]Peer favour's list now have personal names.
    [*]20 more room pieces for each map layout.
    [*]Credit updated to include some forum members.
    [*]Vault added in locker room to store excess novelty to prevent lag.
[/list]

[h1]Cards[/h1]
This is new feature allows you to modify the current map by placing either bonuses on yourself to make the map easier, or if you're doing well; add an extra layer of challenge for a reward in the end.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/210e0a7a7f1735bfe234799d4048976ce538c97a.png[/img]
Card example. This one reduce the map overall difficulty.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/8f42ae158243dedea8bb44241938669e38e51aac.png[/img]
This table will spawn at the starting room of each map. You may play up to three cards per map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32277784/547457da3fcdb0992ccd3b4ed25a02e0af181128.png[/img]
Each map contain two cards; chosen from the map's own card pool. you can get more by trading with friendly peers.
